title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the Kambia, Karene and Port Loko districts of Sierra Leone, contributes to outcome 2.1 Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic wellbeing. The objective is to strengthen the sustainable economic well-being of people living in poverty, especially women and youth. Activities include supporting VSLAs, market assessments and capacity strengthening on business skills, post-harvest management, value addition and linkages to markets. The programme is in partnership with Action for Advocacy and Development Sierra Leone, Cotton Tree Foundation, Kambia District Development and Rehabilitation Organisation, and Social Enterprise Development SL. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:• The sustainable economic well-being of people, especially women and youth, through support for savings and credit groups, business and enterprise training and enterprise capital provision, market systems analysis and solidarity local market engagement initiatives. Capacity strengthening of women and youth, their households and communities is a core element of the approach giving skills to manage finances, group businesses, and to apply product processing and aggregation and marketing technologies.
